cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Dad, I've accepted the museum job. Can you be pleased I'm leaving the workshop? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're thirty. You don't need me to release you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I need the person who taught me to make things to think this counts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pack your tools. You might want to come back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you sharpen them for the museum instead? Send me off expecting me to do well.

mechanism: A confidently manages a job departure while adapting a tool-packing ritual to obtain Dad blessing, though permission is already unnecessary.
confusable: Unlike seeking release from employment, A has accepted the job; borrowed authority presents accommodations as a send-off plan while needing Dad approval.
comparison: Craft mentor and tools differ from a mother toast to a signed household lease.
seedUse: Use D76-a museum/workshop/tools and S02-a revising a announced plan to preserve participation.
